summary: Paket 41 (Yorum Yanıt Taslağı) tested. Backend chain PASS (3/3 pytest): PUT tag → POST draft-replies (drafted>=1) → GET drafts (count>=1 with draft_room_name='Deluxe King Room', response_text non-empty, guest/rating/text present) → POST /api/reviews/{id}/approve (status=responded, drafts count decreases) → edit via submit-for-approval + approve → published response_text starts with 'Edited...' → reject path returns status='rejected'. Auto-tag endpoint returns tagged/processed/source/drafted keys. Frontend testids/selectors all wired correctly in RoomReviewsAdminCard.js (rr-draft-all, rr-drafts, rr-drafts-count, rr-draft-{id}, rr-draft-text-{id}, rr-approve-{id}, rr-reject-{id}) and BookingEngineV2Panel (be-tab-roomreviews). Navigation to BE v2 → Oda Yorumları tab works. Card renders only when a specific property (not 'All Branches') is selected — expected behavior showing 'Üstten bir tesis seçin' otherwise.

minor.issue: Response missed 'drafted' key when there were 0 reviews to process (early return in ai_tag_reviews). FIXED by testing agent — now returns drafted:0 in the no-op branch too.

action_items: None blocking. Backend chain and edited-text persistence via submit-for-approval verified end-to-end. Main agent can self-verify UI by: 1) login admin, 2) select 'Aldgate Flats' from Branch dropdown (top-left), 3) navigate to Booking Engine v2 via Cmd+K or sidebar, 4) click be-tab-roomreviews, 5) click rr-draft-all (LLM up to ~60s), then approve/reject.
critical_code_review_comments: be_extras.py L157 early-return missed 'drafted' key; fixed to satisfy contract.
PUT /booking/room-reviews/{review_id}/tag intentionally does NOT auto-generate a draft; drafts are produced via draft-replies or auto-tag. This matches spec (drafted only in auto-tag response).

success_rate.frontend: Not fully automated (testid wiring & navigation verified; card gating requires branch selection)

seed_data_creation: Tagged 2 unresponded aldgate-flats reviews (Anna Kowalska / Hans Weber pool) to king-aldgate-flats. Approved 1 (edited text 'Edited: ...'), rejected 1 during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for Yorum Yanıt Taslağı (Paket 41) is solid. If UI regressions surface, note that RoomReviewsAdminCard renders only when specific property selected (not 'All Branches'); use the Branch dropdown (top-left) to pick 'Aldgate Flats' BEFORE clicking rr-draft-all. LLM calls up to 60s — use await 70000ms in playwright.
rca of the issue: Missing 'drafted' key in auto-tag no-op response was a contract gap in ai_tag_reviews() early return path. Fixed by adding drafted:0 to the return dict.
